functions.name: Camera_UpdateScroll
functions.summary: Main-loop call #1. Computes scroll/camera position, splits into tile+sub-tile components. Sub-tile X -> [8b69], consumed by Video_FlipAndScroll for EGA pixel-panning. Computes the read pointer (0x4200 + tileX*0x80 + tileY) into the in-memory column-major level-map buffer built by Level_LoadMapIntoScrollBuffer.

functions.name: Level_UpdateAnimatedTiles
functions.summary: Main-loop call #2. Walks the 11x14 visible tile window of the column-major map buffer at [8c13], calling FUN_1000_02e2 for flagged (animated?) tiles. Skipped for world 4.

functions.name: Level_LoadMapIntoScrollBuffer
functions.summary: Called at the end of every World1-4_LoadBanks after the .pap Load_PackedFile call. FUN_1000_1230 (plain copy) then Level_TransposeMapToColumnMajor.

functions.name: Level_TransposeMapToColumnMajor
functions.summary: dest[0x4200+col*128+row] = source[row*128+col] -- transposes the row-major .pap file (confirmed on-disk format, see docs/formats/pap.md) into a column-major in-memory buffer at 6de3:4200 for fast per-column scrolling access.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawFullScreenPicture
functions.summary: The .pip full-screen picture blitter. Direct (unmasked) 320x192 4-plane EGA image, plane-words interleaved per 16px group, picture data starting at file offset 0x22. Plane read order (0,1,2,3 per Map Mask cycling) confirmed from disassembly; plane-to-color-bit mapping does NOT match the textbook EGA convention -- empirically corrected to PLANE_TO_INDEX_BIT=[1,0,3,2] (tools/ega.js) via user visual comparison of candidate permutations, applies to Gfx_BlitSpriteMasked's sprites too. See docs/formats/pip.md.

functions.name: Video_FlipAndScroll
functions.summary: Main-loop call #4. Page-flip (A000/A300) + EGA Attribute Controller index 0x13 write (pixel-panning register) for hardware fine-scroll -- the other AC-index write in the binary besides the CGA palette-select, refining the no-palette-setter finding. Also services the loaded sound driver per frame via computed far call.

functions.name: Fx_UpdateTransition
functions.summary: Main-loop call #5. Dispatches on [8ba2] ('transition/effect ID'): the default case (Fx_TransitionStep) increments it once per frame and feeds it into Video_SelectAndLoadPalette's 24-bank palette-fade table -- CONFIRMED palette-fade transition system between levels/screens, not a screen wipe.

functions.name: Level_UpdateEventQueue
functions.summary: GUESS: main-loop call #6. Walks an opcode/length script structure at [8bb5]; plausible scripted-event/trigger queue.

functions.name: Demo_PlaybackInput
functions.summary: Main-loop call #7. When demo mode active, overrides input with RLE-encoded ([8ba6]) replayed input. See Demo_RecordInput for the write side.

functions.name: Entity_UpdateAll
functions.summary: Main-loop call #8. Walks the entity linked list from 0x91be, skipping +0x40==0x19 dead entries. Per live entity: if(+1!=0) Entity_RunScript() first (opcode-256-jump-table VM), THEN Entity_UpdateBehavior() unconditionally every frame for every entity -- NOT a heavy/light split. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Demo_RecordInput
functions.summary: Main-loop call #9. RLE-encodes current input into [8ba6] when not in playback mode. Pair with Demo_PlaybackInput implements attract-mode demo record/playback.

functions.name: Debug_HandleCheatInput
functions.summary: Main-loop call #10. Debug console: 'p'=single-step, 'q'=vsync-skip, 'b'=hardcoded debug setup, digits 0-9 build a 4-char level-select CHEAT CODE matched against a table at 0xfc2a, warping into World1-4_LoadBanks at a given sub-level.

functions.name: Hud_UpdateScoreDisplay
functions.summary: Main-loop call #12. Converts [8b75] (score/distance) into custom-glyph HUD digits at buffer 0xe70e -- CONFIRMS the Gfx_DrawObject glyph-copy family's 'HUD renderer' hypothesis. Triggers periodic level-progress callbacks; world-3-specific secondary counter past sub-level 7.

functions.name: Rng_NextValue
functions.summary: Main-loop call #13. 16-bit LFSR pseudo-random generator, advanced once per frame ([8b71] state, [8b6b] output).

functions.name: Entity_RunScript
functions.summary: Bytecode VM for entity behavior scripts. Reads opcode bytes from a per-entity script pointer (+0xc, data-segment 6de3 offset), dispatching through a jump table at 1000:2383 -- CORRECTED: 78 entries (0x00-0x4D), not 256; byte offset 0x9C is real code (Entity_ResetExtendedFields), proving the table doesn't extend further. -1/-0xae terminators, -4 special op (EntityScriptOp_ResetScript-adjacent yield). All 78 opcodes characterized, two real scripts decoded byte-exact. Separate VM from Entity_RunMovementAiScript. Full writeup: docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_UpdateBehavior
functions.summary: Per-entity per-frame behavior dispatcher, decoded branch-by-branch for all classes 0-7 plus special pre-check types 8/0x5e/0xf/0x11/0x2f. Gated by [8ba1] mode byte and [8c0c] global-event trigger (8->Entity_SelectNextStateByWorldAndKind defeat table; 0xe/0x14->particle-burst self-kill). Classes 2/4 are AI enemies -> Entity_DispatchUpdateByKind; class3=player (camera/hitbox anchor); class5=parent-attached (types 0x1a/0x41 require parent.type==3, player-carried item); class6=parallax-locked decoration; class7=broadcast/homing; class1=collision/trigger-vs-player. Ext-state 0xf6 is a cross-class tracking sentinel. Full writeup: docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_FreeSlot
functions.summary: Removes a dead entity from a ~140-slot pointer array at 1000:9090-0x91a8 via linear scan + array compaction. Confirms Entity_UpdateAll's list walk operates over this same array.

functions.name: Video_WaitVsyncAndCountFrame
functions.summary: Main-loop call #14 (last). Busy-waits for vsync (port 3DAh), increments frame counter [89f6].

functions.name: Input_KeyboardIsr
functions.summary: The INT 9h keyboard ISR -- found via find_code_gaps, since Ghidra's auto-analysis never created a function boundary here (installed via a raw IVT write, not a traceable DOS set-vector call). Reads port 0x60, tracks Ctrl state, writes raw scancode to [8c87]/[8b60] (the byte App_ExitOrReset polls), looks up the scancode in the 512-word table Config_ParseIniAndLoadSoundDriver built at 1e27, updates [8c94]/[8c85] action bitmasks. This closes the long-standing 'where's the keyboard handler' question.

functions.name: Input_ReadKeyboardState
functions.summary: Combines [8c94] (edge accumulator, cleared after read) with [8c85] (held state) via OR, applies an opposite-direction debounce (mask 0xa0a), stores to [8c91]/[8c90].

functions.name: Input_ReadState
functions.summary: Unified per-frame input reader: calls Input_ReadKeyboardState (also triggers joystick port 0x201), calibrates joystick axes via Input_PollJoystickPort, uses [8c91] instead of joystick data when [8c92]&1==0 (keyboard mode). Result to [8b5d]/[8c8f].

functions.name: Input_PollJoystickPort
functions.summary: Single joystick-calibration-loop iteration: reads port 0x201 twice + vsync status 3DAh, same speed-independent timing trick as Sys_DetectCpuSpeed.

functions.name: Config_ParseIniAndLoadSoundDriver
functions.summary: 4th function entry() calls. Opens/parses pockets.ini: line1->sound driver char [8cab], line2->video driver char [8a5a] (the byte Video_SetMode dispatches on), line3->joystick/keyboard mode [8c92], lines4-8->5 key bindings building a 512-byte keycode->action lookup table at 1000:1e27. Then loads and INVOKES the sound driver .pin file as executable code via a computed far call -- confirms .pin files are loadable driver modules. Keyboard polling/ISR code that consults the 1e27 table not yet located.

functions.name: Config_SkipLine
functions.summary: Line-oriented text scanner: advances SI past the next LF, or backs up onto a NUL. Used repeatedly by Config_ParseIniAndLoadSoundDriver.

functions.name: Gfx_CopyGlyphCell
functions.summary: GUESS: straight CX-row x 4-byte copy, +44/row, no EGA port access. Called from Gfx_DrawObject's numeric-default case (glyph-string rendering, hypothesized HUD/text). See Gfx_CopyGlyphString for the multi-glyph sibling.

functions.name: Gfx_CopyGlyphCellNarrow
functions.summary: GUESS: same as Gfx_CopyGlyphCell but 2 bytes/row (narrower/edge-clipped cell).

functions.name: Gfx_CopyGlyphCellNarrowAlias
functions.summary: Verified pure tail-call alias for Gfx_CopyGlyphCellNarrow.

functions.name: Gfx_CopyGlyphString
functions.summary: GUESS: self-loops over multiple glyphs per call (16 rows x 4 bytes/glyph), decoding the next glyph inline via a sign-magnitude byte transform, decrementing DAT_6de3_8b9c (init 10 by Gfx_DrawObject). Fully-on-screen fast path for the hypothesized HUD/text renderer.

functions.name: Gfx_NoOpStub
functions.summary: Confirmed empty function (immediate RET). Called once from Gfx_DrawObject at 1000:76c1 -- a deliberate no-op clip case.

functions.name: Sys_DetectCpuSpeed
functions.summary: First function entry() calls. Polls port 3DAh (vsync status) counting reads across a vsync cycle to classify the machine fast/slow -- likely selects the undocumented high-speed CGA path. NOTE: appears in disassembly as a far call to CS:2000:0b29 due to real-mode segment:offset aliasing (same linear address as 1ffb:0b79).

functions.name: Gfx_BlitSpriteMaskedWide
functions.summary: Same AND-mask-then-4xOR-plane template as Gfx_BlitSpriteMasked but 3 words (48px)/row, inline sub-pixel shift. Called from Gfx_DrawObject for left-partial-off-screen X positions.

functions.name: Gfx_BlitSpriteMaskedWideB
functions.summary: Same template, 3-word row width, via Gfx_AndMaskRowWide/Gfx_OrPlaneRowWide helpers. Called from Gfx_DrawObject for right-edge (X>=0x140) positions. Exact relationship to Gfx_BlitSpriteMaskedWide not fully disambiguated.

functions.name: Gfx_BlitSpriteMaskedLeftClip
functions.summary: Starts writing at DI+2/+3 (skips first dest word) and reads source one word later -- confirmed left-screen-edge-clip variant. Called from Gfx_DrawObject when X straddles the left edge.

functions.name: Gfx_AndMaskRowWide
functions.summary: AND-mask row primitive for the 3-word/row (wide) sprite class, +44 bytes/row.

functions.name: Gfx_OrPlaneRowWide
functions.summary: OR-plane row primitive for the 3-word/row (wide) sprite class, +44 bytes/row.

functions.name: Gfx_AndMaskRowLeftClip
functions.summary: AND-mask row primitive that skips the leading source/dest word -- used for sprites straddling the left screen edge.

functions.name: Gfx_OrPlaneRowLeftClip
functions.summary: OR-plane row primitive, leading-word-skipped counterpart to Gfx_OrPlaneRow, for left-edge-straddling sprites.

functions.name: Video_SetModeCga
functions.summary: Actual target of Video_SetMode's '4'/'0'/default branches (corrects an earlier mis-description). CGA 320x200 mode set + the only palette-related call in the whole binary (INT 10h AH=0Bh CGA palette-select). See memory-map.md 'Sprite rendering' section for the no-palette-setter finding.

functions.name: Gfx_BlitSpriteMasked
functions.summary: The confirmed EGA sprite blitter: AND an inverted silhouette mask into all 4 bitplanes (Gfx_AndMaskRow), then OR each colour plane in separately (Gfx_OrPlaneRow x4, cycling Sequencer Map Mask). -44 bytes/row, matching the 352px virtual screen width.

functions.name: Gfx_BlitSpriteMaskedAlt
functions.summary: Same algorithm as Gfx_BlitSpriteMasked, inlined, with sub-byte pixel-shift support for non-8-pixel-aligned X positions. Loop bound differs (0x10 vs 0x20) -- likely a different sprite height class, not yet confirmed.

functions.name: Gfx_AndMaskRow
functions.summary: ANDs a mask-bitmap row into all write-enabled bitplanes, -44 bytes/row, with sub-byte shift support via BL/BH edge masks.

functions.name: Gfx_OrPlaneRow
functions.summary: ORs one bitplane's colour-data row into the destination (Map Mask selects which plane beforehand), -44 bytes/row, same shift support.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawObject
functions.summary: Top-level per-object/sprite draw dispatcher, called from FUN_1000_73a5 (one of entry()'s main-loop calls -- confirmed per-frame render path). Switches on object-record byte [SI+0x16] to masked-bitmap draw (clipped, via an unnamed family of edge-clip-case helpers), a probable text/string renderer, or other variants. RESOLVED (raw-disassembly re-trace): the 0x0e/0x0f masked-bitmap paths' entity-type -> tile-index resolution is now fully understood -- shape descriptor field +0x16 (copied to global [0x89e4], distinct from the [SI+0x16] dispatch byte despite the coincidental shared offset) is an addressing-mode switch: !=0 (typically 1) means entity+0xa (current anim frame, init from descriptor animStart) is used directly as a flat tile index into bankToSegment[bankId], same mechanism already confirmed for bank 6; ==0 means entity+0xa instead indexes a near-pointer table (e4fa/e906/dea2, by descriptor kind field +0x18) whose target byte-stream holds the real tile index (still not extracted); ==0xffff reads from live video memory (screen-grab effect, no static tile). See docs/formats/pin-level-script.md's "Entity sprite rendering" section and this function's updated plate comment for the full trace. UPDATE: [8c13] confirmed to be a reused scratch pointer, not a stable level-map pointer -- Camera_UpdateScroll writes it for scroll purposes, but by the time the HUD-text default case runs later in the frame it's been repurposed as a glyph-string source pointer. blocks*.pak's real consumer (World_ResetGraphicsAfterLoad/Gfx_CopyTileBankPlanes, NOT this function) was found in a later session -- see docs/formats/pak.md.

functions.name: World2_LoadBanks
functions.summary: Structurally identical to World1_LoadBanks (same 7 target segments), gated on [8c11]!='2'. Own DAT_1000_b152 filename near-pointers, which cannot be resolved statically -- see openQuestions.

functions.name: World3_LoadBanks
functions.summary: Structurally identical to World1_LoadBanks, gated on [8c11]!='3'. Own DAT_1000_b152 filename near-pointers -- see openQuestions.

functions.name: World4_LoadBanks
functions.summary: Structurally identical to World1_LoadBanks, gated on [8c11]!='4'. Own DAT_1000_b152 filename near-pointers -- see openQuestions. Calls FUN_1000_bd0a only twice (World2/3 call it three times) -- minor structural difference, worth re-checking once filenames are known.

functions.name: entry
functions.summary: Program entry point. Reads PSP command tail, sets SS:SP=6d83:05fe (the real stack), DS=ES=6de3, runs init chain, dispatches to World_Dispatch or falls through, then runs the main loop (~14 subsystem calls per iteration).

functions.name: Video_SetMode
functions.summary: Dispatches on driver-selector byte [8a5a]: 'E'=EGA/VGA16 (reference mode), 'i'=mode 0Dh, 'C'=allocates a 0x800-para buffer once + mode set, 'T'=Tandy (mode 09h, B800, port 3DFh), '4'/'0'=CGA (incl. the undocumented high-speed CGA mode from the 1ffb credits string).

functions.name: App_FatalExit
functions.summary: Unconditional cleanup path (video/keyboard restore, DOS vector restore, close open handles). Reached from entry() when the early init chain fails (<0 return).

functions.name: App_ExitOrReset
functions.summary: Polls exit-reason byte [8b60] for 0x1E (quit to DOS, full cleanup) or 0x13 (re-enter game: reset video mode, reload a bank). Reached from Load_PackedFile's DOS-error path and World_Dispatch's default branch.

functions.name: Sys_RestoreState
functions.summary: Shared cleanup: restore video mode / keyboard state / an INT vector (calls FUN_1000_1dae/0142/2061), then closes handles at [8c9e]/[8ca2] if set. Used by both exit paths above (and inlined again at their tails).

functions.name: World_Dispatch
functions.summary: Switches on global word [8b89] (current world 1..4) to the matching bank loader: 1->World1_LoadBanks, 2->FUN_1000_b6f0, 3->FUN_1000_b8b7, 4->FUN_1000_ba3c. Default calls FUN_1000_b56b then reloads segment 6de3 twice.

functions.name: World1_LoadBanks
functions.summary: Loads world 1's resource banks via Load_PackedFile into segments 2a49,4353,5c53,20e9,3bc3,6a63,6de3 (skipped if already resident per [8c11]). TODO: resolve each DAT_1000_b152 near-pointer to its filename string.

functions.name: Load_PackedFile
functions.summary: LoadPackedFile(DX=near ptr filename, DI=dest offset) -> CX=size. DOS open/read/close into segment [8c75]; if signature 'RN' detected, calls Rnc_Depack in place. Fatal-exits via App_ExitOrReset on any DOS error.

functions.name: Rnc_Depack
functions.summary: RNC ProPack method-1 decompressor entry point. Validates 'RNC\x01' signature, reads chunk count from header+0x11, drives the per-chunk Huffman-table-build + literal/match decode loop. Fully ported to tools/rnc.js in the project repo (see docs/formats/rnc.md); validated against all 60 shipped data files via CRC16.

functions.name: Rnc_GetHeaderWordSwapped
functions.summary: Reads a big-endian header field and byte-swaps it. Only used by Rnc_Depack's DOS in-place-expansion overlap-safety shuffle -- irrelevant to a flat-buffer port.

functions.name: Rnc_BytesToParasRoundUp
functions.summary: Converts a byte count to a rounded-up paragraph (16-byte) count. Only used by the same DOS overlap-safety shuffle as Rnc_GetHeaderWordSwapped.

functions.name: Rnc_DecodeSymbol
functions.summary: Decodes one Huffman-coded value: linear-scans table for (bitwindow&mask)==code, advances the stream by codeLen bits (discarding that result), then returns classIndex directly if <2, else GetBits(classIndex-1)|(1<<(classIndex-1)). Returns via CX, not AX -- see plate comment for the register-preservation subtlety that this depended on.

functions.name: Rnc_GetBits
functions.summary: GetBits(AL=n): consumes n bits (0..16) LSB-first from the two-register (fcbb/fcbd) sliding bit window, refilling from the compressed stream only when needed.

functions.name: Rnc_BuildHuffTable
functions.summary: Reads a canonical Huffman table (count via GetBits(5), then count 4-bit code lengths) and builds bit-reversed (mask,code) pairs plus a per-symbol classIndex used by Rnc_DecodeSymbol. Called 3x per chunk (raw-length, distance, length tables).

functions.name: Video_SelectAndLoadPalette
functions.summary: Selects one of 24 contiguous 32-byte (16-word) palette banks at 6de3:da96 (bank[i]=da96+i*32) and copies it to working buffer [8ae7]. AL==7 special-cases by current world ([8b89]) to banks 7/0x13/0x14/0x15 (worlds 1-4 target palettes); otherwise AL is the bank index directly -- this is how Fx_TransitionStep walks the fade ramp. Bank 0 is runtime-populated (all-zero statically). Calls Video_WaitVsyncAndCountFrame then Video_ApplyVgaPalette (or Video_ApplyPaletteNonVga on non-VGA drivers).

functions.name: Video_ApplyVgaPalette
functions.summary: THE REAL PALETTE SETTER -- only reached when driver [8a5a]=='C' (Colour VGA, what this project's shipped pockets.ini actually selects). Converts the 16 packed palette words at [8ae7] to VGA DAC RGB via Video_ScaleColorComponent (R=hi byte, G=hi nibble of lo byte, B=low 3 bits of lo byte) and programs them via INT 10h AX=0x1002 (set palette regs+overscan), AX=0x1012 (set DAC block, VGA-only), AX=0x101b (gray-scale, gated once). Overturns the earlier 'no palette setter' finding for this driver path.

functions.name: Video_ScaleColorComponent
functions.summary: Scales a 0-7(ish) palette-word color nibble to a 6-bit VGA DAC value: 0->0, else (n*63)/7+6 clipped to 63. Called 3x per color by Video_ApplyVgaPalette.

functions.name: Video_ApplyPaletteNonVga
functions.summary: Non-VGA-driver counterpart to Video_ApplyVgaPalette. Its per-component step (Video_ScaleColorComponentStub) is an empty RET stub -- confirms EGA/Tandy driver paths do not apply a real custom palette and rely on the BIOS default.

functions.name: Video_ScaleColorComponentStub
functions.summary: Empty RET stub -- the non-VGA equivalent of Video_ScaleColorComponent. Confirms non-VGA driver paths compute no real palette.

functions.name: Fx_TransitionStep
functions.summary: Default-case body of Fx_UpdateTransition. Increments [8ba2] once per frame and drives Video_SelectAndLoadPalette through its 24-bank fade-ramp table -- confirms Fx_UpdateTransition is a palette-fade transition system, not a screen wipe. Other opcode values (-5/-4/-3/-2/-1) handle camera re-center, mode re-init (Video_SetMode), and input-gated waits around level transitions.

functions.name: Video_SelectAndLoadPaletteFar
functions.summary: Thin far-call trampoline wrapper around Video_SelectAndLoadPalette.

functions.name: Fx_FadeInWorldPalette
functions.summary: Called directly by all four World*_LoadBanks. Loops Video_SelectAndLoadPalette once/frame (plus AltBuild_TintCgaFramebuffer when the alt-build sentinel is active) until the frame counter reaches 22 -- the fade from black into this world's target palette transition.

functions.name: Fx_FadePaletteLoop29
functions.summary: Structurally identical to Fx_FadeInWorldPalette but runs 29 frames with no CGA-tint branch. Only known caller: Fx_RunCallbackSequenceThenFade. Purpose vs. Fx_FadeInWorldPalette not yet distinguished.

functions.name: Fx_RunCallbackSequenceThenFade
functions.summary: Runs a dynamic callback ([8c29]) 5 times with 11-frame waits (alternating with FUN_1000_be02), then finishes with Fx_FadePaletteLoop29. Plausibly an intro/cutscene sequencer (e.g. the level-select screen animation seen in new.pip).

functions.name: AltBuild_MainLoopEntry
functions.summary: MAJOR STRUCTURAL FINDING: a near-complete duplicate of Fx_TransitionStep's dispatch AND the entire 14-call main loop, living in segment 1ffb (previously known only for CGA/Tandy credits text). Segment 1ffb is an entire alternate build of the runtime, reached when sentinel DAT_1000_22d7 is -1 or 0xff. Worth a dedicated future session.

functions.name: AltBuild_SelectPalette
functions.summary: Alt-build mirror of Video_SelectAndLoadPalette: reads bank index from [8c0d], flags mid-fade state for banks 8-17, looks up a pointer from a table at 1ffb:0x618 by bank.

functions.name: AltBuild_ApplyPalette
functions.summary: Alt-build mirror of Video_ApplyVgaPalette for Tandy/PCjr hardware: loops 16x polling port 0x3DAh then writing one byte to port 0x3DEh from a per-bank table at 1ffb:0x4f0.

functions.name: AltBuild_TintCgaFramebuffer
functions.summary: ORs a fixed bit pattern (5) into a 96x80-byte CGA/Tandy framebuffer region, striding by 0x2000 (classic CGA even/odd-bank split). Plausibly the undocumented CGA mode for very slow machines composite-artifact trick mentioned in the 1ffb credits string. Called only from Fx_FadeInWorldPalette when the alt-build sentinel is active.

functions.name: AltBuild_BuildBitRotateTable
functions.summary: Builds a 256-entry bit rotation/interleave lookup table (one of two algorithms, flag-selected). Likely feeds AltBuild_TintCgaFramebuffer; exact relationship not traced.

functions.name: AltBuild_SelectPaletteThunk
functions.summary: Trampoline into AltBuild_SelectPalette, called from Video_ApplyVgaPalette when DAT_1000_22d7==-1.

functions.name: AltBuild_ApplyPaletteThunk
functions.summary: Trampoline into AltBuild_ApplyPalette, called from Video_ApplyVgaPalette when DAT_1000_22d7==0xff.

functions.name: AltBuild_MainLoopEntryThunkA
functions.summary: Trampoline into AltBuild_MainLoopEntry.

functions.name: AltBuild_MainLoopEntryThunkB
functions.summary: Trampoline into AltBuild_MainLoopEntry (second call site, different sentinel branch).

functions.name: AltBuild_BuildBitRotateTableThunk
functions.summary: Trampoline into AltBuild_BuildBitRotateTable.

functions.name: Level_RewriteAnimatedTileIndex
functions.summary: Level_UpdateAnimatedTiles' per-tile callback. Rewrites the tile-index byte (and sometimes neighboring bytes) in the level map buffer based on current world and old value -- an animation state machine over tile INDICES, not a pixel-drawing function. Ruled out as the blocks*.pak tile-blit consumer.

functions.name: Gfx_ClearFramebufferRegion
functions.summary: REP STOSW zero-fills two 1408-word regions of the current video page at fixed offsets 0x580/0x1760. Called from Gfx_DrawObject and two CGA fallback functions -- a HUD/text-area clear utility, not a tile blitter.

functions.name: Gfx_ResetGraphicsControllerRegs
functions.summary: Resets GC registers 0-5 to defaults plus Color Don't Care/Bit Mask. Cleanup utility called by several Fx_UpdateTransition sub-handlers and Gfx_ClearFramebufferRegion; not a blitter.

functions.name: Gfx_ResetGraphicsControllerRegsAlt
functions.summary: Resets Map Mask/GC Mode/Color Compare/Data Rotate to defaults, only on the non-alt-build driver path. Cleanup utility, not a blitter.

functions.name: AltBuild_CopyCgaFramebufferPage
functions.summary: Tandy/CGA-banking page copy (port 0x3DF bit twiddling from [0xf95b], word-copy loop, calls FUN_1ffb_0c12). Part of the alt-build hardware path, not the main .pak tile blitter.

functions.name: AltBuild_ConvertTileBank
functions.summary: Alt-build-only (no-op on main VGA path). Sets a countdown/pointer pair from a just-loaded buffer then calls AltBuild_ConvertTileBankRows, which copies/rotates 64-word blocks with a 2-phase toggle. Likely a CGA/Tandy tile-format conversion pass, unrelated to blocks*.pak's VGA-path rendering mystery.

functions.name: AltBuild_ConvertTileBankWide
functions.summary: Same shape as AltBuild_ConvertTileBank but processes 256-word blocks via AltBuild_ConvertTileBankRowsWide with a 4-phase toggle -- plausibly a wider/taller tile class's alt-build conversion.

functions.name: AltBuild_ConvertTileBankRows
functions.summary: Core copy/rotate loop for AltBuild_ConvertTileBank.

functions.name: AltBuild_ConvertTileBankRowsWide
functions.summary: Core copy/rotate loop for AltBuild_ConvertTileBankWide, larger block/iteration counts.

functions.name: World_LoadAltBuildBank
functions.summary: Loads an additional file then calls AltBuild_ConvertTileBankWide. Part of World1_LoadBanks' load sequence.

functions.name: World_LoadAltBuildBankVariant
functions.summary: Sets a driver-dependent filename near-pointer then calls AltBuild_ConvertTileBank.

functions.name: World_LoadAltBuildBankAlt
functions.summary: Thin wrapper calling AltBuild_ConvertTileBankWide.

functions.name: World_ResetGraphicsAfterLoad
functions.summary: THE blocks*.pak CONSUMER. Sets ES=0xa800, DS=0x3bc3, DI=SI=0, CX=0x78 (120 tiles) and calls Gfx_CopyTileBankPlanes. Called from all four World*_LoadBanks right after loading blocksN.pak, and from Fx_TransitionStep. See docs/formats/pak.md.

functions.name: World_InitDefaultByteTable
functions.summary: Fills 40 bytes at 1000:9066 with constant 8. Called once per World*_LoadBanks. Purpose not traced further -- ruled out as the blocks*.pak tile-render consumer (no tile/map data touched).

functions.name: World_FlashScreenAfterLoad
functions.summary: Calls FUN_1000_8667 (an Fx_UpdateTransition opcode handler) before and after Video_FlipAndScroll. Last step of every World*_LoadBanks -- plausibly a visual flash/settle finishing touch, not a tile-render trigger. Ruled out as the blocks*.pak consumer.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawObjectHudCaseCgaA
functions.summary: CGA/Tandy fallback for Gfx_DrawObject's 0x0b shape-type case. Reads [8c13] (the same reused scratch pointer as the VGA path's HUD-text case) and runs a 10-row scanline loop -- consistent with being the CGA/Tandy HUD/score-digit renderer, not a background-tile blitter.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawObjectHudCaseCgaB
functions.summary: CGA/Tandy fallback for Gfx_DrawObject's 0x0b case, paired with Gfx_DrawObjectHudCaseCgaA. Not individually decompiled -- assumed parallel structure by analogy with other CGA/Tandy fallback pairs.

functions.name: Snd_TriggerEffect
functions.summary: Sound-effect trigger. Gated on DAT_1000_202b. Driver-type byte [8cab]=='T'/'B' writes (AX+1) into the loaded sound-driver bank (segment 33a9); =='A'/'R'/'S' advances a rotating counter and far-calls the driver entrypoint at [2029]. Called throughout Entity_UpdateBehavior's handlers as the common 'play sound' primitive.

functions.name: Snd_TriggerEffectRaw
functions.summary: Sibling of Snd_TriggerEffect: writes raw (char)AX with no +1 offset and no rotating-counter path for 'A'/'R'/'S' drivers.

functions.name: Entity_AdvanceAnimationFrame
functions.summary: Per-entity animation-frame advance: increments frame counter at +0x3b until reaching in_AL, then resets and steps an index at +0xa toward a target at +0x12, wrapping to the value at +0x10.

functions.name: Entity_HandleCollisionOrStateDispatch
functions.summary: Dispatches on global state [0x8b98] to Entity_ProcessCollisionState15(0x15)/SeparateAndAnimate(0x01)/SnapXByOrientation(0x21)/HandleAnimatedBarrierCollision(0x43)/HandlePeriodicAmbientSpawn(0x41); default path computes a combined collision-flag word and calls Entity_HandleSpecialInteraction or sets up a mutual bounce-state pair. Called from Entity_UpdateBehavior's class-1 branch. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_SelectNextStateByWorldAndKind
functions.summary: Third (world,type)-keyed AI dispatch table, sibling of Entity_DispatchUpdateByKind/DispatchHitReactionByKind. Triggered by Entity_UpdateBehavior when global [0x8c0c]==8; retires each enemy type into its own negative defeat/vanish state constant via Entity_SetStateAndScript (type 0x2b instead adds to score counter [0x8c6b]). Full table + cross-reference: docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_QueueRandomizedSpawn
functions.summary: Computes a randomized spawn position and pushes a spawn event via Entity_PushSpawnEvent (opcode 0xe/0x1b/0x13/0x14 depending on state), or defers to FUN_1000_5440/FUN_1000_bfca.

functions.name: Entity_DispatchUpdateByKind
functions.summary: Per-frame AI 'think' dispatch: switches on world ([0x8b89] falling back to [0x8b8b]) then entity type (+2). Full (world,type)->handler table confirmed exact via raw disassembly -- see docs/enemies.md for the complete table (gates, sleepers, charging hazard, vertical pathfinder, generic patrol variants A-H, custom-tile-table patrol variants). Called from Entity_UpdateBehavior's class 2 and class 4 branches only -- these are the two 'AI-driven enemy' classes.

functions.name: Entity_DispatchHitReactionByKind
functions.summary: 'Just got hit' dispatch, sibling of Entity_DispatchUpdateByKind: sets a hit-stun timer pair (+0x27/+0x26=7), special-cases type 0x2c (always -> Entity_HitReactToState15), then same world->type switch to a family of trivial Entity_HitReactToStateXX leaves (each just sets state+script-pointer constants -- the hex in the name is the state byte written). Type 0x14 (world1) is a genuine exception: dispatches straight back into Entity_RunMovementAiScript instead of a HitReactToStateXX leaf. Full table in docs/enemies.md. A near-identical third copy of this same table exists in Entity_HitReactDispatchByKind (called from inside the movement AI script's 'p'/'q' opcodes).

functions.name: Entity_RollRandomBehaviorIndex
functions.summary: Randomized-behavior gate: rolls Rng_NextValue combined with entity's +0x38 field, indexes a small lookup table at 0xeca4, writes a 0/1 result to [0x8be5]. CONFIRMED deterministic override: when demo record ([0x8ba4]) or playback ([0x8ba3]) flag is set, skips the RNG and forces the result to 1 -- ensures identical enemy behavior during demo/attract-mode playback. Called from nearly every AI think/opcode handler as the 'random chance' gate. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_PushSpawnEvent
functions.summary: Pushes a fixed 8-word event record onto a downward-growing queue at [8bb5] -- matches Level_UpdateEventQueue's opcode/length-tagged buffer noted in docs/engine.md. This is the entity-side producer for that queue.

functions.name: Entity_FindEntityByKind
functions.summary: REVISED: scans a table of 0x42-byte entity records (~0x9356-0xb918, i.e. entity struct size is 0x42=66 bytes, ~146 max entities) for a record whose +2 field matches in_AX (target kind), returning a pointer to the first match. The entity-by-kind lookup AI think-functions use to find their target (e.g. the player).

functions.name: Entity_RebuildVisibleList
functions.summary: KEY FUNCTION for the blocks*.pak background-tile hypothesis: walks the raw ~140-slot entity array at 0x9090 (same array Entity_FreeSlot manages), copies entries into the working list at 0x91be (same list Entity_UpdateAll walks), applies the camera-scroll delta to X/Y, and culls by screen-relative bounds (X in [-0x3f,0x17f], Y in [-0x3f,0xdf]) via a sign-flip marker. This is the per-frame visible-entity list builder Gfx_DrawObject's caller actually walks -- if background geometry is placed as entity records, this is where it gets culled into the render list.

functions.name: Entity_UpdateCameraTargetFromEntity
functions.summary: Recomputes the global camera-scroll delta ([8bb7]/[8bb9]) from the class-3 (player) entity's position vs. the previously stored camera position ([8bbb]/[8bbd]) -- confirms the camera is keyed off the player entity every frame. Called from Entity_UpdateBehavior's class-3 tail. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_SetHitboxByOrientation
functions.summary: Sets the player entity's hitbox size fields ([BX+10]/[BX+6]) to one of two fixed (X,Y) pairs depending on facing orientation ([SI+0x14]==4). Called from Entity_UpdateBehavior's class-3 (player) tail.

functions.name: Entity_HandleWorld3SpecialTrigger
functions.summary: Called unconditionally from Entity_UpdateBehavior's class-3(player) branch every frame world 3 is active. Confirmed as a native 4-phase world-3 boss-defeat reward-shower sequence: watches for kind 0x41 (confirmed as world 3's boss kind via entity-script opcode 0x3A's per-world boss-kind table 0x15/0x40/0x41/0x43) to reach state +0x40==0xf6, then locks player into a victory anim, spawns a 2-event reward shower from a map-buffer-scanned position, runs a ~33-frame follow-up window (setting/reading the [0x8b98] scratch register also used by entity-script opcodes 0x3C/0x3F), then awards a bonus item. CONFIRMED distinct from entity-script-VM opcode 0x44 (EntityScriptOp_RunSpecialInteractionSequence) -- no call-graph link, disjoint globals; earlier 'strengthened lead' guess linking them didn't hold up. See docs/enemies.md's dedicated section.

functions.name: EntityOp_SyncCameraTargetThenUnknown
functions.summary: Thin wrapper: Entity_LookupTypeTableEntry then FUN_1000_e067 (not yet decoded). Likely an Entity_UpdateBehavior opcode-handler entry point.

functions.name: EntityOp_RebuildVisibleList
functions.summary: Thin wrapper calling Entity_RebuildVisibleList -- an Entity_UpdateBehavior opcode-handler entry point for rebuilding the visible-entity list mid-behavior-update.

functions.name: Entity_MoveHorizontalByFlags
functions.summary: Movement primitive: adjusts entity X by in_AX, gated by collision/facing flags at [SI+0x24]. Flags field matches the one Entity_HandleCollisionOrStateDispatch computes into [8c27].

functions.name: Entity_MoveVerticalDownByFlags
functions.summary: Movement primitive: increments entity Y by in_AX unless blocked-downward flag bit is set. Sibling: Entity_MoveVerticalUpByFlags.

functions.name: Entity_MoveVerticalUpByFlags
functions.summary: Movement primitive: decrements entity Y by in_AX unless blocked-upward flag bit is set. Sibling: Entity_MoveVerticalDownByFlags.

functions.name: Entity_BroadcastEventToVisibleByKindFlag
functions.summary: For each visible entity (0x91be list), looks up a per-class flag byte (table indexed by class*8-0xc91) and, if set, calls Entity_CheckAabbOverlapOrBroadcast against it -- an AABB-overlap broadcast to same-class entities. Shared by Entity_UpdateBehavior's class 1 and class 7 branches. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_ProcessCollisionState15
functions.summary: 0x8b98==0x15 handler in Entity_HandleCollisionOrStateDispatch. Manipulates counters at [8b94]/[8b95]/[8b97], triggers Snd_TriggerEffect on transitions. On a completion condition resets several state fields and pushes a spawn event (opcode 0x15) -- plausibly checkpoint/respawn or score-milestone. Not fully decoded.

functions.name: Entity_SeparateAndAnimate
functions.summary: 0x8b98==0x01 handler: resolves collision-flags byte, offsets SI's X by +-4 if blocked left/right and state isn't 0x11, then always calls Entity_AdvanceAnimationFrame.

functions.name: Entity_SnapXByOrientation
functions.summary: 0x8b98==0x21 handler: snaps BX's X position to a fixed value (0x9a or 0x86) depending on its hitbox-size field.

functions.name: Entity_HandleAnimatedBarrierCollision
functions.summary: 0x8b98==0x43 handler: advances BX's animation watching for end-of-cycle frame sentinels (0x2e/0x2d), then blocks/offsets SI's horizontal movement based on collision-flags bits -- an animated barrier/door that also blocks movement.

functions.name: Entity_HandlePeriodicAmbientSpawn
functions.summary: 0x8b98==0x41 handler: increments a counter to 17 then triggers a sound effect and pushes a spawn event at a fixed position -- a periodic ambient sound + spawn trigger (recurring hazard/spawner).

functions.name: Entity_SetStateAndScript
functions.summary: THE entity state->script-pointer resolver referenced in docs/engine.md: sets state byte (+1) and resolves script pointer (+0xc) from one of two tables indexed by state -- positive AL from 0xcd88 (docs/engine.md's known default-script table), negative AL (as AL+0x80) from 0xd996.

functions.name: Entity_MoveXIfStateAllowed
functions.summary: Movement primitive gated by hitbox/flags being clear AND state being in a specific whitelist (0x1d,0x11,0x35,0x5d,0x5b, or SI+1==0xd, or BX+1==0); adds in_AX to SI's X and animates if allowed.

functions.name: Entity_ScriptOpJump
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript's special opcode -4 handler: sets the entity's script pointer (SI+0xc) directly from DI -- a 'jump to script address' bytecode instruction in the entity scripting VM. Actually a fallthrough/yield: saves current position without an operand-byte advance, aborting this frame's script processing (resumes same position next call). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetAnimFrame
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 1 (0x01): sets current anim frame [+0xa] = 1 operand byte. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_WaitFrames
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 2 (0x02): waits until per-entity counter [+0x3e] reaches operand N (retries without advancing until match), then resets counter and advances. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_RelativeJumpBack
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 3 (0x03): script pointer -= operand (relative backward jump, a loop-back construct). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetHitboxSizeOrRandomize
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 5 (0x05): operand 0x00-0x11 sets hitbox [+0x14] directly; 0x12 toggles bits (XOR 0xc); negative operand RNG-picks 4 or 8. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_Kill
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 6 (0x06): sets [+0x40]=0x19 (dead) and aborts. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_TriggerPaletteFade
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 7 (0x07): operand selects a 16-colour palette bank (world-gated) from the 24-bank table (docs/memory-map.md), loads it into the live palette buffer, calls the VGA palette-apply routine (1000:170b). Bridges the entity script VM into the video/palette-fade subsystem. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_PlayDirectionalAnimTable
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 9 (0x09): plays an inline (dx-delta, tile) byte-pair table embedded in the script stream, one pair per frame via entity+0x30 as a rolling byte offset, until a 0xAE terminator. Confirmed against real script data: a 7-step deceleration (-8,-8,-6,-4,-3,-2,-1) and an 8-step deceleration (+14..+0) -- real recoil/approach animations. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_CallStateScript
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 11 (0x0B) 'Call': saves current script position in entity+0x2a (repurposed as a one-level subroutine return slot) then jumps to the default script for state=operand via the cd88/d996 tables. Type==0x42 special-cases a wait on global [0x8b96] instead. Paired with EntityScriptOp_Return. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_Return
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 12 (0x0C) 'Return': resumes from entity+0x2a if set (clears it), else resets the whole script via EntityScriptOp_ResetScript. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SpawnEffectByTypeCode
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 13 (0x0D): NOT a register-reset (initial name was wrong, corrected after decompile). Reads an operand type code and dispatches to ~19 branches spawning positioned effects/items via Entity_PushSpawnEvent/Entity_PushSimpleEvent/Entity_PushPositionEvent/Fx_PushQueuedPositionEvent4/5. Several type codes (0x11,0x1d,0x1f,0x25,0x2b,0x44,0x53) match the nine special opcode types docs/formats/pin-level-script.md flagged in Entity_SpawnFromQueuedEvent. Type code 0xa (fully resolved) dispatches by world/sub-level ([0x8b89]/[0x8b8b]) and a secondary type code from [0x8c69] to Entity_SpawnBreakFragmentOffset0-3 -- confirmed to be the break-fragment/debris spawn effect for the exact per-world breakable-block types docs/enemies.md's ground-collision section catalogs. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_SpawnBreakFragmentOffset0
functions.summary: One of 4 generic 'spawn a break-fragment at position-offset N' functions (0=largest offset) called from EntityScriptOp_SpawnEffectByTypeCode's type-0xa branch. Nudges position by a fixed 2D delta (orientation-gated Y flip via entity+0x14==4) and pushes Fx_PushQueuedPositionEvent5 with the original secondary type code -- the fragment/debris spawn for the per-world breakable blocks docs/enemies.md's ground-collision section catalogs (world1 0xa-0xd, world2 0x30-0x33, world3 0x36-0x38). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_SpawnBreakFragmentOffset1
functions.summary: Sibling of Entity_SpawnBreakFragmentOffset0 (offset index 1, smaller X-magnitude). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_SpawnBreakFragmentOffset2
functions.summary: Sibling of Entity_SpawnBreakFragmentOffset0 (offset index 2, smaller X-magnitude). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_SpawnBreakFragmentOffset3
functions.summary: Sibling of Entity_SpawnBreakFragmentOffset0 (offset index 3, zero X-magnitude). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_SpawnMirroredBreakFragmentWorld4
functions.summary: World4-only pre-pass duplicate of the offset0-3 dispatch, called once when [0x8c03] is nonzero: pushes an extra position event at the current (unmodified) position before the caller restores X/Y and bumps the effect-variant field [0x8c21] -- world4's breakable blocks spawn a second, mirrored fragment alongside the primary one when this flag is set. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_GotoStateScript
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 14 (0x0E): jumps to the default script for state=operand via the cd88/d996 tables, no return saved (a 'goto', unlike opcode 11's 'call'). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_PlaySound
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 15 (0x0F): operand 0 -> CALL 1dae, nonzero -> CALL 1ccf (plausibly Snd_TriggerEffect/Raw variants; call targets not independently re-verified). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_WaitOrLoopBack
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 17 (0x11): like opcode 2's wait, but on mismatch reads a 2nd operand byte and jumps back by it -- a bounded 'count to N, else loop by M'. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_WaitUntilSyncTriple
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 21 (0x15): reads 3 operand bytes, waits (retries) until globals [0x8bb0]/[0x8baf]/[0x8bae] all match -- paired with EntityScriptOp_SetSyncTriple. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_PokeByteValueThenOffset
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 22 (0x16): generic field-write escape hatch -- reads (value, offset), writes value into entity+offset. Argument-order twin of EntityScriptOp_PokeByteOffsetThenValue. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_PokeByteOffsetThenValue
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 35 (0x23): generic field-write -- reads (offset, value), writes value into entity+offset. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetSyncTriple
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 33 (0x21): writes 3 operand bytes into globals [0x8bb0]/[0x8baf]/[0x8bae] -- setter half of EntityScriptOp_WaitUntilSyncTriple's wait-gate. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetAnimSetAndChargeFields
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 34 (0x22): writes 4 operand bytes into [+0x39] (anim-set selector) and [+0x36]/[+0x37]/[+0x38] (charge-threshold fields, per docs/engine.md's struct layout). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_AddToPosition
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 36 (0x24): adds two signed operand bytes to entity X (+6) and Y (+8) -- a direct relative-move opcode. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_ResetScript
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 54 (0x36): clears [+0xc]/[+1] and aborts, causing the script to re-seed from the default-script table next call. Also EntityScriptOp_Return's no-saved-return fallback target. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_WaitUnlessAiActive
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 30 (0x1E): waits (retries) while global [0x8ba1] (AI-freeze flag) is nonzero -- direct cross-reference to docs/enemies.md's Entity_UpdateBehavior AI-freeze finding. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetAiFreezeFlag
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 61 (0x3D): writes operand into global [0x8ba1], the AI-freeze flag -- a script can freeze/unfreeze the entire non-player AI population. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetScrollWidthRegister
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 59 (0x3B): writes operand into [0x8c34], the CRTC/scroll-width register documented in docs/memory-map.md's AltBuild_AdvanceScrollBankState section. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_WaitForBossDefeatThenKillSelf
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 58 (0x3A): per-world boss-kind lookup (0x15/0x40/0x41/0x43), kills self if not found or if found entity's +0x40 == 0xf6 (the cross-class tracking sentinel docs/enemies.md documents). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_CheckBonusMarkerAndMaybeSpawn
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 62 (0x3E): finds a kind-0x18 bonus-marker entity; if its anim frame == 0x7b, calls into the bonus-spawn subsystem adjacent to Entity_ChooseAndSpawnBonusItem (docs/engine.md) and aborts; else decrements the marker AND does ADD byte ptr [0x8bb4],1 (1000:2adb) -- the real setter for [0x8bb4], consumed by EntityScriptOp_RunSpecialInteractionSequence. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetGlobalEventTrigger
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 71 (0x47): writes operand into global [0x8c0c], the special-event trigger docs/enemies.md documents (8->defeat-table dispatch, 0xe/0x14->particle self-kill). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetDeadStateByte
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 40 (0x28): sets [+0x40] (state/dead byte) = operand -- general form of EntityScriptOp_Kill's hardcoded kill. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SpawnLinkedEntityFromTemplateTable
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 49 (0x31): NOT a score-add (initial name was wrong, corrected after decompile). Looks up a template-type byte via [0x8bff]-0x1116, spawns a linked companion via Entity_InitFromTemplateRecord; several branches hardcode the companion's own script pointer to 6de3:c625/ccae -- a preconfigured trailing-effect/companion. Template table contents and companion identity not further traced. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetSpriteShapeOverride
functions.summary: Entity_RunScript opcode 57 (0x39): sets entity+0x16 = operand -- a previously undocumented struct field, plausibly a runtime override of the shape descriptor's frameSourceMode (docs/formats/pin-level-script.md). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_ComputeDirectionAndDistanceToTarget
functions.summary: Core 'sense the target' primitive. Finds target via Entity_FindEntityByKind; computes a 4-bit direction bitmask into [0x8c29] (1=target below,2=above,4=left,8=right) and tile-quantized distances |dx|/32->[0x8c1b], |dy|/16->[0x8c1d]. Used throughout Entity_RunMovementAiScript's chase/attack range checks and the sleeper/gate/vertical-pathfinder handlers. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_CheckOrientationNoOp
functions.summary: Checks SI's orientation (+0x14==4); decompiled body has no observable effect -- likely a register-only side effect lost to decompilation.

functions.name: Entity_MoveXOrResetChargeCounter
functions.summary: If collision flags clear, resets a charge/wind-up counter (+0x2a); otherwise moves X by in_AX and animates if idle.

functions.name: Entity_ScanNearbyTilesForFlag
functions.summary: Scans up to CX bytes from DI through the swappable table at [0xef23] looking for a match to DL -- a tile/collision-flag search helper for patrol/chase AI.

functions.name: Entity_ThinkPatrolAI
functions.summary: Shared patrol foundation: reads 3 tile-lookahead flags via the swappable [0xef23] table (offsets -1,-2,0 from scan pointer [0x8bd7]); both -1/-2 set -> Entity_SelectAiScriptTableBlocked, the 0 flag clear -> Entity_SelectAiScriptTableClear, else -> Entity_SelectAiScriptTableDefault. Each selector points [0x8c77] at one of three opcode-table bases (0xec7c/0xec68/0xec90) offset by animation-set (+0x39), then calls Entity_RunMovementAiScript. Full writeup: docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_SelectAiScriptTableBlocked
functions.summary: Sets [0x8c77] = 0xec7c + animation-set(+0x39), calls Entity_RunMovementAiScript. 'Blocked' terrain case of Entity_ThinkPatrolAI. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_SelectAiScriptTableClear
functions.summary: Sets [0x8c77] = 0xec68 + animation-set(+0x39), calls Entity_RunMovementAiScript. 'Clear path' terrain case of Entity_ThinkPatrolAI. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_SelectAiScriptTableDefault
functions.summary: Sets [0x8c77] = 0xec90 + animation-set(+0x39), calls Entity_RunMovementAiScript. Mixed/edge terrain case of Entity_ThinkPatrolAI. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_RunMovementAiScript
functions.summary: Movement-AI opcode interpreter reading chars from [0x8c77]. Every recognized opcode's role now characterized (docs/enemies.md): 'n'=turn-around/retreat (Entity_AiOpTurnOrRetreat), 'p'=scan tile column ahead then react (Entity_ScanTileColumnForFlag + Entity_DispatchHitReactionByKind), 'q'=scan tiles backward then react (Entity_HitReactDispatchByKind), 'r'=single-tile check then turn, 's'=acquire target + chase/flee/capture decision (Entity_ComputeDirectionAndDistanceToTarget, Entity_AiOpDespawnOrKill/TurnOrRetreat/SpecialByKind), 't'=approach within range then strike with knockback (Entity_HitReactDispatchByKindWithKnockback). Not decoded byte-exact per the ~30 per-animation-set scripts in the 3 tables, but the interpreter itself is fully characterized.

functions.name: Entity_ThinkGateSwitchAI
functions.summary: Shared gate/switch logic for Entity_ThinkSwingingGate/SlidingGate/RotatingGate. While state==0: uses Entity_ComputeDirectionAndDistanceToTarget + Entity_RollRandomBehaviorIndex gating to decide whether to move toward the caller-set target X ([0x8c25]), with per-kind next-state/script constants. On reaching target X, rolls a chance to settle into a parked state family (0xb/0xc/0xd) with an animation-frame lookup from table 0xecfe keyed by charge-threshold field +0x36. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_ThinkSwingingGate
functions.summary: Kind 0x12 (world1). Sets target X ([0x8c25]=0x86) then defers to Entity_ThinkGateSwitchAI. One of 3 gate variants (see docs/enemies.md's gate/switch family writeup) sharing this handler with per-world different target-X constants; Entity_UpdateBehavior's class-4 branch additionally inlines a vertical bob/swing state machine (states 0xd/0xb) specifically for this type.

functions.name: Entity_ThinkPeriodicIdleFidgetA
functions.summary: Kind 0x14 (world1). Frame counter (+0x2e) reaching 10, gated on anim-frame==0xc, rolls a chance to switch to one-shot idle-fidget state 0x89. Delegates to Entity_ThinkPatrolAI otherwise. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_ThinkPatrolDefaultA
functions.summary: Pure 1-line delegate to Entity_ThinkPatrolAI when idle (+1==0). Kind 0x23 (world1). Not a distinct behavior -- same shared patrol logic as B-H, just a separate dispatch-table entry. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_ThinkPatrolDefaultB
functions.summary: Pure delegate to Entity_ThinkPatrolAI when idle (gated on [0x8bc7]==0 and +1==0). Shared by kind 0x13 (world1) and kind 0x4a (world2) via Entity_DispatchUpdateByKind. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_ThinkChargingHazard
functions.summary: Kind 0x20 (world1). Charge counter +0x2a (0-0xc, +-2/frame via random roll), movement via Entity_MoveXOrResetChargeCounter. Kill condition checks [0x8b8b]==6, confirmed to be a sub-level index (not a 5th/6th world) -- the same world-1/sub-level-6 scripted trigger point Level_RunScriptedEventStream independently checks via a byte-identical instruction. See docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: Entity_ThinkPatrolDefaultC
functions.summary: Pure delegate to Entity_ThinkPatrolAI when idle. functions.name: Entity_ThinkEdgeDetectReset

functions.name: Entity_ThinkVerticalPathfinder

functions.name: Game_WarpToLevelStageAndRunLoop

functions.name: Entity_LookupShapeDescriptor

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetPositionOrDequeueTarget
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 8, fully resolved. operand==0 -> tail-calls sibling routine 3af0. operand>0 -> reads a 2nd byte N, sets position to fixed grid coord X=-32N,Y=-16N. operand<0 -> if busy-cache [0x8c5f]!=0, tail-jumps to EntityScriptOp_HandoffToPlayerAndController; else pops a (X,Y,state) record (not type,x,y) from a queue at [0x8c63], advancing it 6 bytes; if popped X==0 (terminator), tail-jumps to EntityScriptOp_RecenterOnAnchorAndHandoff; else teleports self to (X,Y), and either kills the kind==0x2b entity (charging hazard, if state==0) or arms the busy-cache and puts the kind==7 controller entity into the popped state (script resolved via the 0xd996 table). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_HandoffToPlayerAndController
functions.summary: Subroutine of EntityScriptOp_SetPositionOrDequeueTarget (opcode 8), taken when a dequeue is already in flight ([0x8c5f]!=0). Finds kind==3 (the player, per docs/enemies.md) via Entity_FindEntityByKind, sets its state/script to 0x47/0xc967; sets one-shot global [0x8bee]=0xff (also read by EntityScriptOp_RunSpecialInteractionSequence/opcode 68); finds kind==7 (a per-level singleton controller entity) and sets its state/script to 0xf9/0xd922. Newly created/named this pass (was FUN_1000_3b55). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_RecenterOnAnchorAndHandoff
functions.summary: Subroutine of EntityScriptOp_SetPositionOrDequeueTarget (opcode 8), taken when the position/state queue is now empty. Finds kind==0x1c (an anchor/recenter entity, identity unestablished); if found, repositions self relative to it by a fixed (0x90,0x50) offset, zeroes the busy-cache [0x8c5f]/[0x8c61], finds kind==7 and sets its state/script to 0xf9/0xd922, and sets [0x8bee]=1 (vs 0xff in the sibling routine) -- a distinct 'queue drained' completion marker. Newly created/named this pass (was FUN_1000_3b7a). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_AttractModeTimeoutOrRestart
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 52 (0x34). Gated on [0x8b8b]!=0. Increments a high-byte counter [0x8c57] by 0x80/call; on wraparound, fades to black and returns to Game_StartAttractDemoAndRunLoop (idle/attract-mode timeout). Else on a button press ([0x8b5d]&0x80): plays a sound, force-loads World1, clears state, and runs a 5th inlined copy of the 14-call main loop -- the title/demo screen's 'press any button to start' handler. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_ApplyGroundStateByKind
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 74 (0x4A). Calls Entity_ApplyGroundStateTransitionByKind (1000:ee60 -- corrects a prior pass's mistaken belief that this address was uninterpreted data) then a no-op passthrough. Ties the script VM directly into the ground-collision reaction system. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_AdvanceToNextWorld
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 75 (0x4B). Calls Game_AdvanceWorldAndRunLoop (1000:07eb). Scripts can trigger a full world transition/restart directly. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_KillLinkedChildQuiet
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 26 (0x1A). Kills linked child (+0x2c), clears both sides' link field, calls Snd_TriggerEffectRaw. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_KillTrackedEntity
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 73 (0x49). Kills the entity pointed to by +0x2e (dual-use of the 'anim-set-progress counter' field as an entity pointer here), clears the link, calls Snd_TriggerEffect. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_AdoptEntityStateAndScript
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 66 (0x42, corrected numbering -- see docs/entity-script-vm.md's off-by-one note). Finds a target entity's array slot (Entity_FindArraySlotForEntity), copies its state byte (+1) and script pointer (+0xc) onto self -- self 'becomes' the found entity's current behavior state/script.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_AddSignedByteToScore
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 50 (0x32). [0x8b75] += (signed char)operand -- adds to the running distance/score global Hud_UpdateScoreDisplay reads. Corrects a prior pass's mismatched description of this address (which actually described the neighboring opcode 49's code).

functions.name: Game_AdvanceWorldAndRunLoop
functions.summary: A 4th physical copy of the 14-call main loop (alongside entry, Game_WarpToLevelStageAndRunLoop, Game_StartAttractDemoAndRunLoop). Increments [0x8c29]; 1-4 loads World1-4 banks respectively (World3 also remaps tiles), else sets fatal-exit flag [0x8ba3] and falls back to World1. Clears entities; if world index [0x8b89]==0 starts the attract demo, else runs the inlined main loop directly. Reached from EntityScriptOp_AdvanceToNextWorld -- entity scripts can trigger a full world transition/restart.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetPaletteFadeState
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 64 (0x40). [0x8ba2] = operand -- directly sets the palette-fade transition step counter Fx_UpdateTransition/Fx_TransitionStep drive once per frame. This opcode was entirely missing from the original 78-entry table transcription (an off-by-one counting slip skipped this word); see docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_AddSignedDeltaAtOffset
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 65 (0x41, corrected numbering). Reads (offset, signed delta), adds delta into the word at entity+offset -- generic 'add' twin of the poke-byte primitives (ops 22/35).

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SetAnimLockFlag
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 67 (0x43, corrected numbering). Sets +0x3d = operand -- the 'animation-lock' field Entity_InitFromTemplateRecord's decompile also names.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_SpawnRandomizedBonusNearFixedPoint
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 77 (0x4D). Newly created/named this pass (was uninterpreted -- not a Ghidra function before, address-only in docs). CORRECTS a prior guess ('renders via 1000:c035'): 1000:c035 is Entity_PushSpawnEvent and 1000:11fc is Rng_NextValue (both already-named). Advances the RNG, reads 1 operand byte as the spawned entity's type ([0x8c1f]), uses fixed base position X=0x90,Y=0x48 with layout-selector [0x8c29]=0xf, branches on [0x8b6b] bit0 to choose a position-offset variant, looks up [0x8b6b]&0xf in a 16-byte table at 0xee36 to pick the spawn variant ([0x8c21]), then calls Entity_PushSpawnEvent. Used repeatedly in the opcode-68 reward-shower cutscene template. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_RunSpecialInteractionSequence
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 68 (0x44, corrected numbering). Dense ~700-byte dispatcher. If entity type(+2)==3: branches on world/sub-level to hardcoded per-(world,sublevel) cutscene sub-scripts (world1 sublevel6, world2 sublevel7, world3 sublevel>7). Otherwise: finds+kills a tracked entity then reacts to a chain of one-shot global flags, each jumping to a fixed sub-script address or playing a sound. All 11 destination scripts (cd03/cd1b/cd33/d2b0/d381/d280/d298/d306/d2cf/d2ee/d31f) walked byte-exact this pass -- confirmed to all be instances of one shared 'reward-shower' spawn/sound/score celebration template, not bespoke content; cd03/cd1b/cd33 additionally confirmed as overlapping tail entry points into one physical byte stream, not 3 independent scripts. Structurally parallel to Entity_InteractionPhaseJumpTable (not proven identical). See docs/entity-script-vm.md and docs/enemies.md.

functions.name: EntityScriptOp_DispatchSpeedTickByKind
functions.summary: Entity-script opcode 55 (0x37). Dispatches on kind(+4): 1->Entity_TickKind1SpeedDecay, 7->Entity_TickKind7SpeedByWorldOrSublevel, 2->Entity_TickKind2VerticalBounce, 4->Entity_TickKind4BounceWithRandomTurn; generic fallback adjusts speed via coordinate helpers. A generic bouncing/patrol physics-tick family keyed by kind, distinct from Entity_RunMovementAiScript and the docs/enemies.md AI-think dispatch. All 4 kind handlers now decoded.

functions.name: Entity_TickKind7SpeedByWorldOrSublevel
functions.summary: Kind-7 physics tick (called from EntityScriptOp_DispatchSpeedTickByKind; was FUN_1000_ddba, decoded and named this pass). Reads [0x8b89] (world) or, if 0, [0x8b8b] (sub-level) as a 1-4 selector. Values 1/3/4 share the generic vertical-bounce-then-horizontal-move shape of the kind 1/2/4 siblings. Value 2 has an extra special case: when own type(+2)==0x33, gated on global [0x8c03], fully reinitializes self as a different entity (hitbox/speed/state cleared, +1 set to 0xa8/0x67, +0xc script pointer force-set to 0xd150/0xcbea) -- plausibly a boss phase-transform/respawn trigger.

functions.name: Entity_TickKind1SpeedDecay
functions.summary: Kind-1 physics tick (called from EntityScriptOp_DispatchSpeedTickByKind). Moves Y by a decaying speed value (+0x26), an occasional kind-0x11 special reset after 10-16 ticks, then moves X by +0x27 gated on hitbox/collision flags (+0x14/+0x24).

functions.name: Entity_TickKind2VerticalBounce
functions.summary: Kind-2 physics tick (called from EntityScriptOp_DispatchSpeedTickByKind). Vertical bounce via Entity_MoveVerticalUpByFlags/DownByFlags with a sign-toggle at the zero-crossing, then a horizontal move via Entity_MoveHorizontalByFlags.

functions.name: Entity_TickKind4BounceWithRandomTurn
functions.summary: Kind-4 physics tick (called from EntityScriptOp_DispatchSpeedTickByKind). Vertical bounce plus horizontal move; on reaching a symmetric endpoint, rerolls direction via Entity_RollRandomBehaviorIndex and XORs collision flags (+0x14) to reverse.

functions.name: Entity_PairWithType1cPropAndArmCutscene
functions.summary: Reached from Entity_DispatchInteractionByOtherEntityType's CMP AX,0x1c case (paired entity BX has type/shape-class 0x1c -- entity-shapes.json descriptor 28, bank 6/extras, a small 2-frame prop). Requires caller idle + same Y as BX; scans 5 candidate X offsets (0/+4/+8 unconditional, -4/-8 gated on [0x8b98]==0x15, the world-1 boss-kind sentinel). On match: reassigns caller's script pointer to 6de3:c967, sets [0x8c2f]=[0x8c2d] (the world1/sublevel6 cutscene-step-counter source, resolving that docs/entity-script-vm.md open question), plays two sounds, kills BX. One of 3 recovered entries in Entity_InteractionPhaseJumpTable's previously-unrecoverable table. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_DispatchInteractionByOtherEntityType
functions.summary: Entity_InteractionPhaseJumpTable phase handler (table index 7). Dispatches on AX=[BX+2] (paired entity's type/shape-class): 0xe->1000:58d5, 0x1c->Entity_PairWithType1cPropAndArmCutscene, 6->1000:59a9, 0x1b->Entity_InteractionPhaseType1bHandler, 0x26->1000:5b26, 0x56->1000:5b70, 0x2e->1000:5b8b, and a per-world boss/special-kind set ({0x15,0x40,0x41,0x43,0x1a,0x24,0x2a,0x45,0x22,0x29}) that stores BX into global [0x8c01] (a new 'last-matched-entity' register). Internal jump targets 58d5/59a9/5b26/5b70/5b8b not traced further. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_InteractionPhaseStateSetters
functions.summary: Entity_InteractionPhaseJumpTable phase handler (table indices 10 and 14, both resolving to the adjacent 1-byte RET stub at 1000:57a2 -- effective no-op phases). Checks own shape-class(+2)==6 or anim-set byte(+0x39)==0x49 combined with +2 in {0x12,0x14} to pick: toggle a hitbox/orientation bit ([BX+0x14]^=0xc), mark dead (+0x40=0x19), or set state 0xf6 ('tracks another entity', see docs/enemies.md) with +0x2c=BX. Narrative purpose not pinned down. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_InteractionPhaseType1bHandler
functions.summary: Reached from Entity_DispatchInteractionByOtherEntityType's CMP AX,0x1b case. Dispatches further on its own AX (0x1e/0x67/0x1f/0x20, targets 5d73/5d84/5d9c/5c96/5d5e not traced). Contains a checkpoint-style wait loop (1000:5c23) that spins while [0x8c04]!=0, then kills BX and writes [0x8c04]=0xe. At 1000:5c36-5c40: ADD word ptr [0x8bff],1 once per call until it reaches 6 -- the real setter for [0x8bff], resolving that docs/entity-script-vm.md open question.

functions.name: Entity_InteractionPhaseResolveHitAndPairing
functions.summary: Entity_InteractionPhaseJumpTable phase handler, table indices 12 (entry here) and 1 (entry at 1000:4639, 13 bytes in, skipping the opening 'BX type!=0x25 -> kill BX' guard -- same function, two entry offsets). Dispatches on BX's type (0x2c, 0x2b->Entity_ArmChargingHazardInteraction), on [0x8c04]=='@' (a boss-hit sub-branch, one path calling Entity_SpawnLinkedTemplateEntity), then a [0x8b98]-keyed dispatch (0x15=world1 boss sentinel, 'C'=ground-transition-or-burst-reward, -1=no-op, '!'/'A'->Entity_ChooseAndSpawnBonusItem, 1/3->Entity_ResolveInteractionRewardAndBonusMarker, 0x1a->entity-list scan for a transform-state match). Default fallback (self+BX both idle): generic two-entity pairing -- BX state 0x44/script 0xc92c, self state 0x45/script 0xc94d, [0x8b96]=0x3c, [0x8b98]=3 -- the exact constants Entity_PairWithType1cPropAndArmCutscene also uses, confirming that function specializes this general mechanism. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_KillSelfInteractionPhase
functions.summary: Entity_InteractionPhaseJumpTable phase handler (table index 2). One-liner: self.state(+0x40)=0x19 (dead). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_KillOtherInteractionPhase
functions.summary: Entity_InteractionPhaseJumpTable phase handler (table index 3). One-liner: BX.state(+0x40)=0x19 (dead) -- the 'kill the other party' counterpart to index 2. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_InteractionPhaseResolveBreakOrHazard
functions.summary: Entity_InteractionPhaseJumpTable phase handler (table index 4). Dense (~650 bytes) per-world hit/break dispatcher over BX's type against per-world breakable/hazard type ranges (mirrors docs/enemies.md's ground-collision type catalog), assigning settle states via Entity_SetStateAndScript/Entity_SelectNextStateByWorldAndKind/Entity_ResolveInteractionRewardAndBonusMarker. Special-cases BX type==0x2b (charging hazard): world4/sublevel9 exempted from being killed, otherwise reset to state 0x29/script 0xc6ea, +0x32 score, Entity_SpawnBreakBurstEffect. Structure/key constants confirmed, not every per-world branch narratively pinned down. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_InteractionPhaseResolveByWorldAndType
functions.summary: Entity_InteractionPhaseJumpTable phase handler (table index 5). Per-world dispatch over the same breakable-block type ranges docs/enemies.md's ground-collision section catalogs (world1 0xd/0x10, world2 0x33/0x34, world3 0x38/0x39, world4 0x3a-0x3e) into a shared break-and-reward epilogue. World2 type 0x33 is distinct: gated on [0x8b98] (0/1/0x1a, the player-carried-item type docs/enemies.md documents for class 5), a distance check either sets a new one-shot flag [0x8beb]=0xff (its own downstream reader not traced) or repositions/reinitializes the found entity. World4 types 0x3a-0x3d run a ground-contact chain via Entity_MoveHorizontalByFlags/Entity_ApplyGroundStateTransitionByKind. Dense (~840 bytes), structure/key constants confirmed. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_ArmChargingHazardInteraction
functions.summary: Called from Entity_InteractionPhaseResolveHitAndPairing's BX-type==0x2b branch. Finds the charging-hazard entity (Entity_FindEntityByKind), sets its collision flags to 0x8f. World4/sublevel9 defers to Entity_SpawnLinkedTemplateEntity; otherwise resets its position/anim-range, arms [0x8b96]=0x28 (wait-countdown), sets self to state 0x2f/script 0xc79f, clears a cluster of difficulty/session counters ([0x8c03],[0x8bf1],[0x8bff],[0x8bb2],[0x8b93]=1,[0x8b90]=6) -- plausibly a 'charging hazard defeated, reset run-difficulty state' sequence. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_SpawnLinkedTemplateEntity
functions.summary: Trivial 2-call wrapper: Entity_InitFromTemplateRecord() then FUN_1000_596b() (not traced). Reached from Entity_InteractionPhaseResolveHitAndPairing when BX type==0x53 and BX anim-frame(+0xa)==0x104. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.name: Entity_ResolveInteractionRewardAndBonusMarker
functions.summary: Shared 'resolve a destroyed hazard/breakable-block interaction' primitive, called from Entity_InteractionPhaseResolveHitAndPairing/ResolveBreakOrHazard. Increments HUD counters [0x8c05]/[0x8c06]; resets self (and linked child +0x2c) to state 1/script 0xc45b (the already-decoded 'state 1 = EntityScriptOp_Kill' script); plays two raw sounds; pushes a position event whose type tag is chosen by which special-tag field is set (anim-set 0x15, state '@'/0x40, anim-set 'A'/0x41, state 'C'/0x43); marks self processed (state=0x65); calls Entity_SpawnBreakBurstEffect + a sound; calls the already-named Entity_ChooseAndPlaceBonusMarker (with a guaranteed extra bonus spawn when [0x8b98]=='A'). See docs/entity-script-vm.md.

functions.summary: Shared 4-particle burst-spawn helper: 4x Fx_PushQueuedPositionEvent5 (a 2x2 grid of offset variants 4/8 x 4/8, effect type 0xf/variant 9) at the staged [0x8c25]/[0x8c27] position. Called from Entity_ResolveInteractionRewardAndBonusMarker and the interaction-phase break/hazard handlers. See docs/entity-script-vm.md.
